from pathlib import Path
from tempfile import NamedTemporaryFile
from zipfile import ZipFile
from bioblend.galaxy import GalaxyInstance

history_id = 'bbd44e69cb8906b59245f6758530c259'
key = Path('/run/secrets/galaxy_api_key').read_text().strip()
gi = GalaxyInstance('https://usegalaxy.org', key=key)
items = [
    ('inputs/scogs_animals.zip', '.faa.mafft.clipkit', 'animals_alignment_member_names.txt'),
    ('inputs/scogs_animals.zip', '.faa.mafft.clipkit.treefile', 'animals_tree_member_names.txt'),
    ('inputs/scogs_fungi.zip', '.faa.mafft.clipkit', 'fungi_alignment_member_names.txt'),
    ('inputs/scogs_fungi.zip', '.faa.mafft.clipkit.treefile', 'fungi_tree_member_names.txt'),
]
for archive, suffix, out_name in items:
    with ZipFile(archive) as zf:
        names = sorted(n for n in zf.namelist() if '/' not in n and n.endswith(suffix))
    with NamedTemporaryFile('w', encoding='utf-8', suffix='.txt', dir='/workspace', delete=False) as fh:
        fh.write('\\n'.join(names) + '\\n')
        tmp = fh.name
    result = gi.tools.upload_file(tmp, history_id, file_name=out_name, file_type='txt')
    jobs = result.get('jobs', []) if isinstance(result, dict) else []
    outputs = result.get('outputs', []) if isinstance(result, dict) else []
    print(out_name, len(names), [(o.get('id'), o.get('name')) for o in outputs], [j.get('id') for j in jobs])
    Path(tmp).unlink()
PY"
